definitions.explanation: A male deer, especially one with antlers. The counterpart of {雌鹿|めじか} (female deer, doe).

examples.japanese: {雄鹿|おじか}が{森|もり}にいた。
examples.english: There was a stag in the forest.

examples.japanese: {立派|りっぱ}な{角|つの}を{持|も}つ{雄鹿|おじか}を{見|み}かけた。
examples.english: I spotted a stag with impressive antlers.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{雄鹿|おじか}は{縄張|なわば}りを{守|まも}るために{鳴|な}き{声|ごえ}を{上|あ}げる。
examples.english: In autumn, male deer cry out to defend their territory.

notes:
Composed of {雄|お} (male) and {鹿|しか} (deer). Also written as {牡鹿|おじか}. The {鹿|しか} becomes じか through rendaku (sequential voicing). Part of a common pair with {雌鹿|めじか} (female deer, doe).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雄鹿|おじか}の{角|つの} — a stag's antlers
- {雄鹿|おじか}と{雌鹿|めじか} — stag and doe
- {若|わか}い{雄鹿|おじか} — a young buck

RELATED WORDS:
- {雌鹿|めじか} — female deer, doe
- {鹿|しか} — deer (general)
- {子鹿|こじか} — fawn, young deer
- {角|つの} — horn, antler
